Open your download.

Open mac-check.zip, then double-click Mac Check.command. In Terminal, press Return. Your report will open in your browser.

macOS may ask you to confirm opening the file. The website itself cannot launch Terminal.

See an example report ↗
Need another way?

After unzipping, open Terminal and paste:

zsh ~/Downloads/'Mac Check.command'

Or drag the unzipped file into Terminal after typing zsh , then press Return.

Open your report ↗

Read-only checks. Only the last four serial characters appear.
A local report is evidence; it does not certify ownership or test a factory reset.
